# JusRental — Rental Property Platform for Bangalore

## About
JusRental is a zero-brokerage rental property platform focused on North Bangalore.
We connect property owners directly with verified tenants. Every listing is personally
verified by our team with accurate photos, genuine pricing, and real-time availability.

## Website Structure
- / — Homepage with property showcase, area explorer, testimonials
- /properties — Browse verified rental properties with filters (area, budget, BHK, type, furnished)
- /properties/[id] — Individual property detail page with photos, amenities, pricing, and nearby places
- /properties/hennur — Rental homes in Hennur with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /properties/hebbal — Rental homes in Hebbal with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /properties/yelahanka — Rental homes in Yelahanka with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /properties/thanisandra — Rental homes in Thanisandra with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /properties/devanahalli — Rental homes in Devanahalli with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /properties/horamavu — Rental homes in Horamavu with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /properties/jakkur — Rental homes in Jakkur with area guide, rent ranges, FAQs
- /list-property — Property owners can list their rental property for free
- /rent-estimator — Estimate rental rates by area and BHK configuration
- /blog — Rental tips, market trends, neighbourhood guides
- /blog/[slug] — Individual blog post
- /contact — Contact form and WhatsApp support
- /book-visit — Schedule a property visit
- /nri-services — Property management services for Non-Resident Indians
- /rental-agreement — Rental agreement information and templates

## Key Features
- 100% verified property listings — every property is personally inspected
- Zero brokerage for tenants — no hidden charges
- WhatsApp-first communication — quick responses and easy scheduling
- NRI-friendly property management — tenant discovery, rent collection, maintenance
- Real-time availability updates
- AI-powered SEO optimization for property listings
- Area-specific guides with rent ranges, connectivity info, and FAQs

## Coverage Areas
North Bangalore: Hennur, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Thanisandra, Devanahalli, Horamavu, Jakkur

## Property Types
- Apartments (1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4+ BHK)
- Villas
- Independent Houses
- Furnished, Semi-Furnished, and Unfurnished options

## Typical Rent Ranges (North Bangalore)
- 1 BHK: ₹7,000 – ₹22,000/month
- 2 BHK: ₹12,000 – ₹40,000/month
- 3 BHK: ₹18,000 – ₹70,000/month
